sources.entry: ILLA Cloud - Low-code internal tool builder. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/illacloud/illa-builder)

summary.one_liner: ILLA Builder is the open-source front end of ILLA, a low-code platform for developers to build internal tools from drag-and-drop components and actions.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ILLA as a low-code platform for building internal tools using a library of components and actions. Tools are built by dragging UI components (charts, tables, forms, and others) onto a canvas, with overlapping components repositioned automatically. Data is connected through GUI data connectors, with MySQL and REST API named explicitly; the README says more databases and APIs will be added. Real-time collaboration and automation of connected services are listed as features. Apps can be deployed and self-hosted, with Docker, docker-compose, and k8s mentioned as deployment options, plus an ILLA CLI for faster deployment. The README also notes that the builder's i18n locale files are synced via Crowdin.
use_cases: create dashboards with charts and tables
connect a MySQL database to a UI
connect REST APIs to a visual app builder
collaborate on building internal apps in real time
how_to_run: Sign up and log in to ILLA Cloud (hosted option)
Deploy ILLA manually with Docker, docker-compose, or k8s (see README for details)
Use the ILLA CLI to deploy ILLA Builder
After deployment, register with an email address or log in with the default credentials documented in the README
notable: Drag-and-drop canvas with built-in components and automatic overlap adjustment
Self-hostable via Docker or k8s, with an ILLA CLI
Localized UI with docs in English, Simplified Chinese, German, and Japanese
caveats: The README says more than 10 databases and APIs will be added soon, so the current connector list is limited to MySQL and REST API as named
Self-hosting requires Docker, docker-compose, or k8s setup; the README gives few detailed steps and links out for them
keywords: share internal tools with my team
